gloss: lean meat; red meat; red flesh (of fish)

definitions.explanation: Meat with little fat, showing a red color. Used for both beef and other meats to distinguish lean cuts from fatty ones.

definitions.gloss: red-fleshed fish (such as tuna or bonito)
definitions.explanation: Fish with red-colored flesh, as opposed to white-fleshed fish. In sushi terminology, refers specifically to the lean part of tuna.

examples.japanese: {赤身|あかみ}の{肉|にく}が{好|す}きだ。
ステーキには{赤身|あかみ}の{多|おお}い{部位|ぶい}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a cut with more lean meat for the steak.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{脂身|あぶらみ}より{赤身|あかみ}を{食|た}べるようにしている。
examples.english: For my health, I try to eat lean meat rather than fatty meat.

examples.japanese: まぐろの{赤身|あかみ}をください。
examples.english: I'll have the lean tuna, please.

examples.japanese: {赤身|あかみ}の{魚|さかな}は{鉄分|てつぶん}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: Red-fleshed fish are rich in iron.

examples.japanese: この{寿司屋|すしや}の{赤身|あかみ}は{新鮮|しんせん}で、{口|くち}の{中|なか}でとろける。
examples.english: The lean tuna at this sushi restaurant is so fresh it melts in your mouth.

notes:
A compound of {赤|あか} (red) and {身|み} (flesh/meat), referring to meat or fish flesh that is red in color and lean.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤身|あかみ}の{肉|にく}: lean meat
- まぐろの{赤身|あかみ}: lean tuna
- {赤身|あかみ}の{魚|さかな}: red-fleshed fish
- {赤身|あかみ}{部分|ぶぶん}: lean portion

SUSHI TERMINOLOGY:
At sushi restaurants, {赤身|あかみ} refers to the leanest part of tuna, as opposed to {中|ちゅう}トロ (medium fatty tuna) and {大|おお}トロ (fatty tuna belly). {赤身|あかみ} is the most affordable of the three and has a clean, straightforward flavor.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脂身|あぶらみ}: fatty meat — the opposite of {赤身|あかみ}; the white fatty portion of meat
- {白身|しろみ}: white-fleshed fish — fish with pale flesh like sea bream or flounder; also refers to egg white
